game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Spider Den, a webbed spider den: the shadow ranger must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Spider Den: a webbed spider den
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.

win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 230, or lives reach 0.
